Name: Lilly's Tinkaton (Pokemon)
Author: Letsgolilly
Description:
Adds Tinkaton as a Barn animal.
She will "gather" metal items for you at night.
These can be smelted into bars or crafted into weapon replicas.
These replicas can be traded for the real thing at the Adventurer's Guild. 
Tinkaton can be purchased at Marnie.
If you're lucky you might even buy a shiny one.

You can get Dolls of Tinkaton, Corviknight and Bisharp if you download my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29334]Skitty[/url] mod.
